```java
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
```

```java
public class ScalarProductSaturated {
    public static int[] scalarProductSaturated(int[] vec, int a) {
        if (vec == null) return null;
        int ret[] = new int[vec.length];
        for (int i = 0; i < vec.length; i++) {
            long prod = (long) vec[i] * (long) a;
            if (prod > Integer.MAX_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
            } else if (prod < Integer.MIN_VALUE) {
                ret[i] = Integer.MIN_VALUE;
            } else {
                ret[i] = (int) prod;
            }
        }
        return ret;
```
```java
    }
}
```

public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
```java
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
```

```
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
```
```java
                    return false;
                }
            }
```
```java
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
```

```java
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;

            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;

                wordStart = false;
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {

    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
```
```java
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

    }
```

```java
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
public class DivArrayByTwo {
    //@  requires arr == null;
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr != null;
    //@  assigns arr[*];
    //@  ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; arr[i] == \old(arr[i]) / 2;
    //@ behaviors complete;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static void DivArrayByTwo(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null)
            return;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= arr.length;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; arr[j] == \old(arr[j]) / 2;
        //@ maintaining \forall int k; i <= k < arr.length; arr[k] == \old(arr[k]);
        //@ loop_writes arr[*], i;
        //@ decreases arr.length - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length; ++i) {
            arr[i] = arr[i] / 2;
        }
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

Please generate JML specifications for the Java program given below.
```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
      @     i == 5 ? "five" :
      @     i == 6 ? "six" :
      @     i == 7 ? "seven" :
      @     i == 8 ? "eight" :
      @     i == 9 ? "nine" : null));
```
```java
      @ also
      @ public normal_behavior
      @ requires digit < 0 || digit > 9;
      @ ensures \result == null;
      @ assignable \nothing;
      @*/
    public static String digitToString(int digit) {
        switch (digit) {
            case 0: return "zero";
            case 1: return "one";
            case 2: return "two";
            case 3: return "three";
            case 4: return "four";
            case 5: return "five";
            case 6: return "six";
            case 7: return "seven";
            case 8: return "eight";
            case 9: return "nine";
```
            default: return null;
```java
        }
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
      assigns \nothing;

        //@ maintaining \forall int k; 0 <= k < i ==> a[k] != null && a[k].length == n;
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
```

```java
            return false;
```

```
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
```
```java
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> (\exists char c; c == arr[j]; ret[j] == (wordStart ? Character.toTitleCase(c) : Character.toLowerCase(c))));
```

```java
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
```
```
        }

        return ret;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))

            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
```

```java
            i = i + 1;
        }
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {

        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
```

```java
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {
```

```java
        }
```

```java
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
```

public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
```java
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
```
```java
        }

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    /*@ public normal_behavior
      @ requires arr != null;
      @ ensures \result == null || (\forall int i; 0 <= i < \result.length; Character.isWhitespace(\result[i]) ==> \result[i] == arr[i]);
      @ ensures \result != null ==> \result.length == arr.length;
      @ ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; Character.isWhitespace(arr[j])) ==> Character.isWhitespace(\result[j]);
      @ ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j])) ==> Character.isLowerCase(\result[i]);
      @ ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < arr.length; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[i]) ==> (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; Character.isWhitespace(arr[j])) ==> Character.isTitleCase(\result[i]);
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @*/
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; (Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]) && (!Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> (j == 0 || Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]) ==> Character.isTitleCase(ret[j]) && !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j-1]) ==> Character.isLowerCase(ret[j]));
        //@ loop_writes ret[*], i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
```
```
            }
        }

        return ret;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {

    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();

    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;

        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);

        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
```

```java
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {

            i = i + 1;

        return true;
```

```
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
```
```java
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
```
```java
                    return false;
```
```java
                }
            }
```
```java
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
```

```java
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
```
```java
        //@ requires x != null && y != null && x.length == y.length;
        //@ assigns \nothing;
        //@ ensures (\forall int index; 0 <= index && index < x.length; x[index] == y[x.length - 1 - index]);
        //@ ensures \result == true;
        //@ also
        //@ ensures !(\forall int index; 0 <= index && index < x.length; x[index] == y[x.length - 1 - index]);
        //@ ensures \result == false;
```
```java
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= index && index <= x.length;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < index; x[i] == y[x.length - 1 - i]);
        //@ loop_invariant (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < index; x[i] == y[x.length - 1 - i]);
        //@ loop_writes index;
        //@ decreases x.length - index;
        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
```
```java
                index = index + 1;
```
```java
            }
```
```java
        }
        return true;
```
```java
    }
```

```java
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];

        return ret;
```
```java
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;

        return true;
```
```java
    }
}
```

Please generate JML specifications for the Java program given below.
```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {

        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; 
        //@     (digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
        //@     (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
        //@     (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||

        //@     (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6));
        //@ loop_writes \nothing;
        //@ decreases len / 2 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
      ensures \result == ((a > 0 && b > 0 && (long)a + (long)b > Integer.MAX_VALUE) ? Integer.MAX_VALUE :
                        (a < 0 && b < 0 && (long)a + (long)b < Integer.MIN_VALUE) ? Integer.MIN_VALUE : (a + b));
    @*/
    public static int sumSaturated(int a, int b) {
        long sum = (long)a + (long)b;
        if (sum > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        if (sum < Integer.MIN_VALUE)
            return Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        return (int)sum;
```

```java
    public static int romanNumeralToDec(char N) {
        switch (N) {
            case 'i':
            case 'I':
                return 1;
            case 'v':
            case 'V':
                return 5;
            case 'x':
            case 'X':
                return 10;
            case 'l':

                return 50;
            case 'c':

                return 100;
            case 'd':

            case 'm':
```

```java
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
public class RotateMatrix180 {
```
```
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
```

```java
            return false;
```

```java
public class MatrixSum {
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;

        int[][] c = new int[n][m];

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                c[i][j] = a[i][j] + b[i][j];
```

```java
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        //@ maintaining 1 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int k, l; 1 <= k && k < i && 1 <= l && l < m; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1]);

            //@ maintaining (\forall int k, l; 1 <= k && k < i && 1 <= l && l < j; mat[k][l] == mat[k - 1][l - 1]);
```

```java
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;

        }

    }
```

```java
public class AllUnique {
    public static boolean allUnique(int[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return true;

        for (int i = 0; i < arr.length - 1; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < arr.length; j++) {
                if (arr[i] == arr[j]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```java
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
```

```java
    public static boolean isLeapYear(int year) {

        if (year % 4 == 0) {
            if (year % 100 == 0) {
                if (year % 400 == 0)
                    leap = true;
                else
                    leap = false;
            } else
```

```java
    public static long calculate(int num1, int num2, char operator) {

        long output;

        switch (operator) {
        case '+':
            output = (long)num1 + num2;
            break;

        case '-':
            output = (long)num1 - num2;
            break;

        case '*':
            output = (long)num1 * num2;
            break;

        case '/':
            output = (long)num1 / num2;
            break;

        case '%':
            output = (long)num1 % num2;
            break;

        default:
            return -1;
        }

    }
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
```

```java
    //@  requires txt != null;

    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
```

```java
public class ArrayConcat {
    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;
```

```java
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
        int n = a.length;
        int m = a[0].length;
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;

        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```java
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
```

Please generate JML specifications for the Java program given below.
```java
public class IsReverseArray {
    public static boolean isReverseArray(int[] x, int[] y) {
        if (x.length != y.length)
            return false;
        int index = 0;

        while (index < x.length) {
            if (x[index] != y[x.length - 1 - index]) {
                return false;
            } else {
                index = index + 1;
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}

```

```java
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
```

```java
    public static int max(int[] a) {
        if (a == null || a.length == 0)
            return Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        int res = a[0];
```

```java
        //@ maintaining 1 <= i <= a.length;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; a[j] <= res);
        //@ loop_writes res, i;
        //@ decreases a.length - i;
        for (int i = 1; i < a.length; i++) {
            res = ((a[i] > res) ? a[i] : res);
        }
        return res;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IdxMaximum {
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class SumSaturated {
    public static int sumSaturated(int a, int b) {
        long sum = (long)a + (long)b;
        if (sum > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        if (sum < Integer.MIN_VALUE)
            return Integer.MIN_VALUE;
        return (int)sum;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
```
```java
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
```

```java
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsIdentity {
    public static boolean isIdentity(int[][] a) {
```

```java
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;

    //@ also

    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {

            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
```

```java
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;
```

```java
        //@ maintaining 1 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int x, y; 1 <= x < i && 1 <= y < m; mat[x][y] == mat[x - 1][y - 1];
```

```java
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```java
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
```

```java
public class Add {
    public static int add(int x, int y) {
        int sum = x;
        if (y > 0) {
            int n = y;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum + 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
```

```java
public class ReverseArray {
```
```java
    //@ requires original != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \fresh(\result);
    //@ ensures \result.length == original.length;
    //@ ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result.length; \result[i] == original[\result.length - 1 - i];
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
        int n = original.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; res[j] == original[n - 1 - j];
        //@ loop_writes res[*];
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            res[i] = original[n - i - 1];
        }
        return res;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
      @ requires a != null && b != null && (long) a.length + b.length <= Integer.MAX_VALUE;
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result != null && \result.length == a.length + b.length;
      @ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < a.length; \result[i] == a[i]);
      @ ensures (\forall int i; 0 <= i && i < b.length; \result[i + a.length] == b[i]);
      @ also
      @ public exceptional_behavior
      @ requires a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE;
      @ assigns \nothing;
      @ ensures \result == null;

    public static int[] arrayConcat(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null || (long) a.length + b.length > Integer.MAX_VALUE)
            return null;

        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[j] == a[j]);

        //@ decreases m - i;
```

```java
public class IsUndirectedGraph {
    public static boolean isUndirectedGraph(int[][] adjacencyMat) {
        int nVert = adjacencyMat.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < nVert; i++) {
            for (int j = i + 1; j < nVert; j++) {
                if (adjacencyMat[i][j] != adjacencyMat[j][i]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }
        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        while (i < pat.length()) {

        return true;
    }
```

```java
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
      @                 \result[i][j] == a[i][j] + b[i][j]));
      @*/
    public static int[][] matrixSum(int[][] a, int[][] b) {
```

```java
        //@                         c[x][y] == a[x][y] + b[x][y]));

            //@ loop_writes c[i];
            //@ decreases m - j;
            for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {

            }
        }

    }
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);

        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```java
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
        //@ loop_writes i;
        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    public static int idxMaximum(int[] a) {
        if (a.length == 0)
            return -1;

        int index = 0;
        int biggest = 0;

        while (a.length - index > 0) {
            if (a[index] > a[biggest]) {
                biggest = index;
            }
            index = index + 1;
        }
        return biggest;
    }
}
```

```java
public class CompareArray {
    public static boolean arrcmp(int[] a, int[] b) {
        if (a == null || b == null) {
            return a == b;
        }
        if (a.length != b.length) {
            return false;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < a.length; i++) {
            if (a[i] != b[i]) {
                return false;
            }
        }
```

```java
public class ReverseArray {
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
        int n = original.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {

        if (pat.length() > txt.length())

        while (i < pat.length()) {
```

```java
public class Add {
    public static int add(int x, int y) {
        int sum = x;
        if (y > 0) {
            int n = y;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum + 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        } else {
            int n = -y;
            while (n > 0) {
                sum = sum - 1;
                n = n - 1;
            }
        }
        return sum;

}
```

```java
    public static int add(int x, int y) {

        if (y > 0) {
            int n = y;

            //@ maintaining n >= 0;
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

Please generate JML specifications for the Java program given below.
```java
public class IsRectangleOverlap {
    public static boolean isRectangleOverlap(int[] rec1, int[] rec2) {
        int left1   = rec1[0];
        int bottom1 = rec1[1];
        int right1  = rec1[2];
        int top1    = rec1[3];

        int left2   = rec2[0];
        int bottom2 = rec2[1];
        int right2  = rec2[2];
        int top2    = rec2[3];

        return !(bottom2 >= top1 ||
                 top2 <= bottom1 ||
                 left2 >= right1 ||
                 right2 <= left1);
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@ also
    //@  requires arr != null;
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();

    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;

            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);
```

```java
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
```

```java
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    //@ requires digits != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result <==> (digits == null || digits.length == 0 ||
```
```java
    //@                      (\forall int i; 0 <= i < digits.length / 2;
    //@                       (digits[i] == 0 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 0) ||
    //@                       (digits[i] == 1 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 1) ||
    //@                       (digits[i] == 8 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 8) ||
    //@                       (digits[i] == 6 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 9) ||
    //@                       (digits[i] == 9 && digits[digits.length - i - 1] == 6)) &&
    //@                      (digits.length % 2 == 0 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 0 ||
    //@                       digits[digits.length / 2] == 1 || digits[digits.length / 2] == 8));
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= len / 2;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i;
        //@              (digits[j] == 0 && digits[len - j - 1] == 0) ||
        //@              (digits[j] == 1 && digits[len - j - 1] == 1) ||
        //@              (digits[j] == 8 && digits[len - j - 1] == 8) ||
        //@              (digits[j] == 6 && digits[len - j - 1] == 9) ||
        //@              (digits[j] == 9 && digits[len - j - 1] == 6));
        //@ loop_writes \nothing;
        //@ decreases len / 2 - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
```
```java
            //@ assert mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8 || mid == 6 || mid == 9;
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8 || mid == 6 || mid == 9;
        }

        return true;
```

```
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        if ((len % 2) == 1) {
            int mid = digits[len / 2];
            return mid == 0 || mid == 1 || mid == 8;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@ requires original != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \fresh(\result);
    //@ ensures \result.length == original.length;
    //@ ensures \forall int i; 0 <= i < \result.length; \result[i] == original[\result.length - 1 - i];
    public static int[] reverse(int[] original) {
        int n = original.length;
        int[] res = new int[n];

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; res[j] == original[n - 1 - j];
        //@ loop_writes res[*];
        //@ decreases n - i;

            res[i] = original[n - i - 1];
        }
        return res;
    }
}
```

```java
            return null;
        
        int m = a.length;
        int n = b.length;
        int[] ret = new int[m + n];
```

```java
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= m;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[j] == a[j]);
        //@ loop_writes ret[0..m-1], i;
        //@ decreases m - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            ret[i] = a[i];
        }

        //@ maintaining 0 <= i && i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j && j < i; ret[j + m] == b[j]);
        //@ loop_writes ret[m..m+n-1], i;
        //@ decreases n - i;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            ret[i + m] = b[i];
        }

        return ret;
    }
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        while (i < pat.length()) {
            if (pat.charAt(i) != txt.charAt(i))
                return false;
            i = i + 1;
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsPrefix {
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));
    //@ also
    //@  requires pat != null;
    //@  requires txt != null;

            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    //@ requires arr != null;
    //@ assigns \nothing;
    //@ ensures \result != null && \result.length == arr.length;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= n;
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> ret[j] == arr[j]);
        //@ maintaining (\forall int j; 0 <= j < i; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[j]) ==> (ret[j] == Character.toTitleCase(arr[j]) && (\forall int k; 0 <= k < j; !Character.isWhitespace(arr[k]) ==> ret[k] == Character.toLowerCase(arr[k])));

                wordStart = true;

                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
public class RotateMatrix180 {
    public static int[][] rotateMatrix180(int[][] A) {
        if (A == null || A.length == 0) return null;
        if (A[0] == null || A[0].length == 0) return null;
        int m = A.length;
        int n = A[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < m; i++) {
            if (A[i] == null || A[i].length != n) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        int[][] ret = new int[m][n];

        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                ret[i][j] = A[m-1-i][n-1-j];
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() <= txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == (\forall int i; 0 <= i < pat.length(); pat.charAt(i) == txt.charAt(i));

    //@  requires txt != null;
    //@  requires pat.length() > txt.length();
    //@  assigns \nothing;
    //@  ensures \result == false;
    //@ behaviors disjoint;
    public static boolean isPrefix(String pat, String txt) {
        if (pat.length() > txt.length())
            return false;

        int i = 0;
        //@ maintaining 0 <= i <= pat.length();
        //@ maintaining \forall int j; 0 <= j < i; pat.charAt(j) == txt.charAt(j);

        //@ decreases pat.length() - i;
```

```java
public class IsIdentity {
```

```java
public class IsToeplitzMatrix {
    public static boolean isToeplitzMatrix(int[][] mat) {
        if (mat.length == 0) return true;
        int n = mat.length, m = mat[0].length;

        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                if (mat[i][j] != mat[i - 1][j - 1]) {
                    return false;
                }
            }
        }

        return true;
    }
}
```

Please generate JML specifications for the Java program given below.
```java
public class IsStrictlyMonotonic {
    public static boolean isStrictlyMonotonic(int[] nums) {
        boolean inc = true, dec = true;
        int n = nums.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < n - 1; ++i) {
            if (nums[i] >= nums[i + 1]) {
                inc = false;
            }
            if (nums[i] <= nums[i + 1]) {
                dec = false;
            }
        }
        return inc || dec;
    }
}
```

```java
public class TitleCase {
    public static char[] titleCase(char[] arr) {
        if (arr == null) return null;

        int n = arr.length;
        char[] ret = new char[n];

        boolean wordStart = true;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            char c = arr[i];
            if (Character.isWhitespace(c)) {
                ret[i] = c;
                wordStart = true;
            } else if (wordStart) {
                ret[i] = Character.toTitleCase(c);
                wordStart = false;
            } else {
                ret[i] = Character.toLowerCase(c);
            }
        }

        return ret;
    }
}
```

```java
public class IsStrobogrammatic {
    public static boolean isStrobogrammatic(int[] digits) {
        if (digits == null || digits.length == 0) return true;

        int len = digits.length;

        for (int i = 0; i < len / 2; i++) {
            int a = digits[i];
            int b = digits[len - i - 1];

            if (!((a == 0 && b == 0) ||
                  (a == 1 && b == 1) ||
                  (a == 8 && b == 8) ||
                  (a == 6 && b == 9) ||
                  (a == 9 && b == 6))) {
                return false;
            }
```
